craft_notes: Sthāyin: mudrā-vīra of sealing — girt-am → nectar-life → eightfold-circle → seals-all → loosed-called → draught-dwells → moment-rises → effortless-all; the treatise seals effortless. Moment-rises below-flashes; rite-standers addressed. Rejected: (a) moment→instant → killed: moment ticks. Read aloud: EACH-mo-ment RIS-es KNOW-ing … KNOW-it, MA-he-ŚA's RITE-stand-ERS.

lines: Each moment rises knowing — there indeed it flashes, below —
world Śiva-power-glory-formed — know it, Maheśa's rite-standers.
l4.sanskrit_cite: pratikalam udeti saṃvid yā kila tatra sphuraty adho viśvam śivaśaktivibhavarūpaṃ jānanti maheśa yāgasthāḥ

reads_against.argmap: What rises momently? → Momently rising flashing below; rite-standers know glory-formed world.
c1_essence: Sealed all delighted throng by fullness-shown.
Conquering draught dwells clearly; stain known.
In-me flashing sealed; rite complete effortless.
reads_against.c1_rasa: raudra-vīra of ghoul-girt am-I; amṛta-bhakti of heart-shining; adbhuta of eightfold retinue; mudrā-vīra of sealed all; mudrā-vīra of called seal; vīra of conquering draught; adbhuta of momently rising; śānta of sealed rite
